text: Tonight: set one small goal for your child for tomorrow (‘put your shoes in their place before bed’). One small goal is more successful than a long list.

review_defects.arabic: ضع حذاءك في مكانه قبل النوم
review_defects.english: put your shoes in their place before bed
review_defects.why: Arabic uses singular 'حذاءك' (your shoe) while English uses plural 'shoes'.
